page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a non-threaded execution environment. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.2xlarge is structured for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high parallel compute scaling. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute resources, such as small-scale databases, caching layers, or lightweight enterprise applications.
